opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers to OneCoin token accounts, points them to a signup invitation, and ties the tokens held there to packages that must be purchased. Those packages are presented alongside mining and an early position in the mining pool, while the displayed account records include mining-token entries, a Starter Package, and split-bonus entries. The presentation also describes escrow periods and online training as benefits of participating and a way to profit. Taken together, the purchasable packages, signup route, mining position, bonuses, and profit-oriented participation show a paid token-return pitch, while the displayed balances and prices do not establish verified mining proceeds.

citations.quote: Token accounts is where all your tokens are stored depending on what package that you buy.
